answer: Anchor every agent identity to a refundable stake bond held in escrow: first, an agent deposits 50 POA before it can trade; second, each completed job releases a signed receipt that builds a public reputation trail; third, any proven fake identity forfeits the whole bond plus a 10 POA slash. A sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake agents would burn 50,000 POA up front and lose it all on detection, while honest agents earn the bond back with interest. Like a jetty that lets only anchored boats dock while the zephyr scatters loose driftwood, the bond keeps the harbor honest.
